messages:
Marta (People Ops): Thanks for the great turnout at today's all-hands. Dropping a follow-up thread for the leveling/comp/benefits questions we could not get to. Ask follow-ups here and I'll tag owners. :mailbox_with_mail:

Owen (Infra): Quick one: if a promotion is approved on the day payroll runs, does the raise show up that same pay or next? Any retro rules?

Marta (People Ops): Short answer: if People Ops finalizes approval before payroll cutoff, we'll include it in that run; otherwise it applies to the next payroll. Retro pay to the start of the review period is possible only if the manager requests it within 30 days of the People Ops approval timestamp and Finance signs off. Exceptions >30d need Exec sign-off.

Lily (Eng Manager): Clarify "People Ops approval timestamp"  is that when manager submits or when we finish calibration? We get asked this a lot.

Marta (People Ops): It's the People Ops finalization timestamp in the HR system (when we mark the promotion approved). That's the canonical time for payroll, retro eligibility, and appeals windows.

Diego (Finance): Adding: year-end bonus treatment depends on declaration date. Promotions approved before declaration are treated at the new level; after that we prorate by days-at-level. Manual payroll retro entries may take up to two pay cycles to appear.

Owen (Infra): Mid-search level bump: if a req moves from L2->L3 mid-interview, should Recruiting update candidate bands immediately or wait for calibration to lock?

Marta (People Ops): Update the req/band immediately and flag active candidates. Recruiting should notify candidates of the change and coordinate with Hiring Manager + Finance for any unsigned offers. Signed offers are not usually changed unless agreed.

Lily (Eng Manager): Parental leave follow-up: employee on leave missed open enrollment deadlines. Can we make exceptions?

Benefits-Bot: Qualifying life events (birth/adoption) permit mid-year enrollment. If open enrollment was missed due to being on-leave, submit a ticket to people-ops@redwood.com with dates and we'll evaluate. Tag @Benefits-Bot to create the case.

Ava (CEO): Leadership ask: can People Ops publish a concise one-pager that covers promotion timeline, payroll effects, retro window, appeals steps, and manager checklist? Keep it short and actionable.

Marta (People Ops): Absolutely. I'll draft the one-pager + a 3-point manager checklist (docs to prepare, deadlines, appeal instructions) and post it here by Friday. Will pin it for a week.

Owen (Infra): One last: equity refresh eligibility after promo  what do we tell folks?

Marta (People Ops): Guideline = refresh conversations typically after ~6 months at new level. Managers can recommend exceptions during comp windows; approvals need People Ops + Finance sign-off.

Marta (People Ops): Thanks all. If you have a private case, DM me and put "private appeal" in the subject. I'll keep this thread pinned for the week. :pushpin:
